title: How to Pay Creators for UGC Usage Rights: Rates, Contracts, and Payment Workflows
summary: Learn how to pay creators for UGC usage rights, from setting rates and structuring contracts to automating global payouts. Includes benchmarks, templates, and step-by-step workflows.
body_markdown:
## Build a Contract and Payment Workflow You Can Repeat


A signed agreement makes a negotiated offer usable permission and a payable obligation. Keep the contract, invoice or payment details, approved asset, and campaign record aligned, then confirm planned use matches the signed scope before launch. Consult an attorney familiar with your jurisdiction and campaign needs for legal terms; platform policies and local requirements can also affect content and payments.


### Include These Terms in Every Usage-Rights Agreement


Identify the licensed asset and creator, then specify permitted channels, placements, formats, paid-media use, territory, term, and start date. State whether exclusivity or attribution applies, which edits are allowed, and whether the brand may crop, caption, or adapt the content. Record deliverables, payment amount and timing, renewal or extension fees, and termination or takedown processes. Spell out approval steps before the content runs.


### Use a Rights Checklist Before Sending the Contract


Check that the document matches the negotiated offer: correct asset, approved channels, organic or paid use, named ad format, territory, dates, and any creator-handle permissions. Confirm the fee, payment trigger, invoice requirements, and renewal terms. Verify the creator understands permitted edits and the campaign team knows the expiration date. A checklist catches scope gaps before signature, when changes are easier to resolve.


### Move From Rights Request to Approved Payout in Six Steps


Use the same sequence for each agreement: document the asset and intended scope; confirm the fee and payment conditions; send and obtain signatures; collect the invoice or required payment details; verify the approved asset, deliverables, and authorized use; then issue payment and record the rights expiration. Assign an owner to each handoff so a signed agreement stays connected to the campaign and finance process.


### Handle Invoices, Records, Renewals, and Global Payments


Store invoices, signed terms, payment confirmations, asset versions, and usage dates together. Reconcile payment against the agreed fee, and schedule a review before the license ends. For international creators, confirm the available payout method, required tax documentation, currency, and country-specific payment rules before promising a payment date. Availability and obligations vary by location; verify requirements with qualified finance or tax support.


Usage Rights and Reacher Wallet supports usage-rights requests inside the CRM workflow and paid usage-rights offers with Wallet payouts where supported. Approved video downloads are available from the CRM. Keep offers connected to assets and agreed payments, and confirm each campaign’s terms and payment availability directly.
